map.月用电 600 kWh、当地年发电 1300 kWh/kWp、组件单价 3.5: Monthly electricity 600 kWh, local annual generation 1300 kWh/kWp, module price 3.5 CNY/W, electricity price 0.58 CNY/kWh: recommended capacity about 5.5 kWp, annual generation about 7150 kWh, covering about 80% of consumption, initial investment about 19250 CNY, payback about 7-9 years. Tip: with subsidies and escalating tariffs the payback is shorter.
map.自发自用和余电上网哪种收益高？: Which yields more, self-consumption or surplus feed-in?
map.自发自用节省零售电价，通常高于上网电价，因此提升自用率（加储能、错峰用电）收益更: Self-consumption saves the retail electricity price, usually higher than the feed-in tariff, so raising the self-use rate (adding storage, shifting usage off-peak) yields better returns; feed-in serves only to dispose of surplus power.
map.回收期受哪些因素影响最大？: Which factors most affect the payback period?
map.当地辐照、自用比例、初始投资单价与电价/补贴政策；辐照高且自用率高时回收期显著缩: Local irradiation, self-use ratio, initial investment unit price and electricity price/subsidy policy; with high irradiation and a high self-use ratio the payback period shortens notably.
